products.name: Zeemo
products.note: Video captioning AI; translation; subtitle styling; content accessibility

profile_text.body:
Zeemo describes itself as an all-in-one AI studio for image, video, and caption creation, positioning the platform as a single workspace where users can generate images, video, audio, captions, and music without switching between tools. The company's site highlights a range of specific functions including adding subtitles to video, transcribing video and audio to text, translating video, and extracting captions, alongside generative tools such as an AI cartoon video generator, an AI pixel video generator, and an AI reel maker. Target audiences listed on the site include content creators, educational institutions, and media companies.

The held facts identify Zeemo's core product under the Video Generation and Editing category, noting its focus on video captioning, translation, subtitle styling, and content accessibility. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
